title: Designing reading experiences for machine-made text
description: How typography, pacing, TOC/anchor structure, and dark-mode contrast shape trust in AI-assisted articles, using this site’s post.html template as the worked example.
lead: Machine-made text fails on pacing, not grammar. Typography, navigable structure, and honest contrast are what make AI-assisted articles worth trusting — using this site’s own article template as the worked example.
